_meta.description: Real, gdallocationinfo-verified per-site GAEZ AEZ33 classification and HIH suitability score for every FAO-selected final-location site currently in this deployment catalog. Captured 2026-09-05 via batched gdallocationinfo -wgs84 -valonly against the live source COGs (see per-entry score_cog/aez33_cog fields), one process per raster with all sites for that raster piped via stdin (not one process per point). Coordinates are bbox-center approximations of each real final-location polygon feature from the live depot.optgeo.org GeoJSON files, matching this project standing practice (D13/D35/D41) -- not exact polygon centroids.
_meta.purpose: Durable backing data for scaling NARRATIVES.md (DECISIONS.md D45) -- both the per-site honest-profile narratives and any further commodity-level divergence analysis should read from this file rather than re-fetching/re-deriving.

known_sentinel_sites.note: score field is the literal string "-999", FAO's own hidden NoData sentinel (D10) baked into a real selected site's own pixel -- never present this as a real score in a generated narrative; the site's polygon exists and is real, only its own score pixel is bad data.
